name: The Cove Eleuthera
insider_take: Hidden on a 180-acre pink sand peninsula, this adults-only sanctuary feels like your own private Bahamian island kingdom.
whats_special: The Cove sits on legendary Rainbow Bay, where the Atlantic Ocean meets the Caribbean Sea in a stunning display of contrasting blue hues. Eleuthera's famous pink sand beaches get their rosy tint from tiny crushed shells and coral - creating some of the most photographed coastlines in the world. The island stretches 110 miles long but is only 1-2 miles wide, offering dramatic ocean views from almost every vantage point.
pro_tip: Book a sunrise fishing excursion from the resort's private marina - Eleuthera's waters are home to bonefish, tarpon, and marlin, making it a world-class fishing destination that's surprisingly uncrowded.
dont_miss: The Glass Window Bridge, just 30 minutes away, where you can literally stand between two different colored oceans. Visit Leon Levy Native Plant Preserve to see rare Bahamian flora, or explore the mysterious Ocean Hole - a 660-foot deep inland blue hole that's perfect for snorkeling and surrounded by ancient limestone formations.
pros: Pristine pink sand beaches with crystal-clear turquoise waters
Intimate boutique resort with personalized luxury service
World-class diving and snorkeling in untouched coral reefs
Exclusive access to secluded coves and private beach areas
cons: Remote island location requires additional travel planning
Limited nightlife and dining options outside the resort
